description: Read-only: writes the TEXT of a trade list for the user to copy and post themselves (WhatsApp, Discord, anywhere). It posts nothing, sends nothing and publishes nothing (style: whatsapp | discord | text; default whatsapp): list "deck" (the deck's missing cards, linked by its wantlist link), "wantlist" (the personal wantlist's missing cards) or "tradelist" (what the user's published tradelists offer, linked by their handle). One line a card: count, name, the printing when the list pins one, a flag for a language other than English (one with no flag is written as its name), and on a tradelist each copy a deck of the user claims or plays shared named with that deck (lines[].breaks_decks): relay it. `cards` keeps only those names. Relay `text` as it is, in a code block or ready to copy. This tool NEVER publishes: when url is null no link is live yet — the note says which create_share_link call would publish it; ask the user before calling it, then call this again.

cards.description: Only these card names (English); omit for the whole list

deck.description: Deck id or name, for list "deck"

name: draft_trade_post

breaks_decks.description: A tradelist's copies a deck of the user's claims or plays shared: the text names the deck, and so must you

image_uri.description: The card's picture on Scryfall, to show as it is; null when the catalogue has none

is_proxy.description: A PROXY on a tradelist: the text names it, and so must you

lang.description: Scryfall's language code; not English is flagged in the text

set_code.description: The printing, when pinned (a want) or offered (a tradelist)

rule.description: A tradelist: the rule to pass create_share_link

publish.description: With no live link: what create_share_link would publish to carry this post. Ask the user first

text.description: The message to post, ready to copy: relay it as it is

url.description: The live link the message ends with; null: none is published, and the text has no link

title: Draft a trade post
